rationale: Darren is a serial founder rebuilding KinkBNB as a web3 privacy-first marketplace and needs technical infrastructure—Saurabh specializes in applied AI and developer tooling with full-stack capabilities across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Darren's conviction that crypto wallet-based identity and blockchain architecture solve payment processing barriers in adult platforms could benefit from Saurabh's hands-on experience shipping AI agents and infrastructure-adjacent projects, while Darren's 30 years in e-commerce and marketplace operations offer mentorship on scaling and operations.
intro_message: Saurabh Khire, meet Darren Mckeeman — Darren is raising to scale KinkBNB's web3 marketplace and could use a technical co-builder with your full-stack AI and developer tooling background; Darren's two decades managing e-commerce infrastructure and blockchain expertise could help you move into marketplace-scale problems.
